scripts.eval:skills: cd .agents && claude plugin eval . --allow-tools Bash Edit Write --scaffold --trust-plugin --no-publish -j 4 --max-cost-usd 25 --judge-model sonnet
scripts.build:ui: npm run generate && vp build livery
scripts.check: npm run build:ui && npm run check:ts && npm run check:rust
scripts.check:ts: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p core/monitor && tsc -p livery && tsc -p website && tsc -p website/.storybook && vp lint --max-warnings=0 && vp fmt --check
scripts.test: npm run build:ui && npm run test:ts && npm run test:rust
scripts.verify: npm run build:ui && vp build website && npm run check:ts && npm run check:rust && npm run test:ts && npm run test:rust && npm run verify:knip --workspace website
scripts.git:config: git config pull.rebase true && git config merge.ff only
